title: Assisted workspace flow (happy path)
env: Environment: dtp.ltsgroup.tech (web test) · Screenshots taken 05 Nov 2026 · Prepared by QA
intro: This document walks through the main success path of an Assisted workspace: SGS imports and activates a framework, the customer creates a scope and a workspace, uploads evidence against a requirement and keeps a new version of the document.

SGS Portal = the portal at /ops used by SGS Admins and SGS consultants. Screenshots taken before 06 Nov 2026 show its old header name "Operations Console"; the web now shows "SGS Portal". It is the same portal.
Test data created for this run is prefixed "[QA] D05 Smoke". Times shown in DTP are Taiwan time (UTC+8); the URL bar time is GMT+7. Red boxes and labels were added for this document.

tables.heading: Data created in this run
rows: [QA] D05 Smoke Assisted 0851 (code QA_D05_SMOKE_0851, from the Appendix 10 template: 113 requirements, 3 tiers, 79 expected evidence)
[QA] D05 Smoke Assisted WS 0851 (tier Medium, cycle 2026–2029)

limitations: Malware scanning of uploads cannot be shown from the QA laptop: Symantec deletes the standard test file before it reaches DTP. Uploads in this run are clean PDFs.
The test environment uses a mock sign-in with a password. On the SGS environment users sign in through Microsoft Entra, so the login screen will look different.
Emails (for example invitations) go to the test mail catcher, not to real inboxes.

steps.what: Import a framework from the Excel template.
body: Upload the DTP framework import template (English and Traditional Chinese), let DTP check the file, review the content and import it. To update an existing framework, the same framework_code is uploaded with a higher content_version.
shots: Step 1 Upload file: the template file is ready, then Check file.
Step 2 Check file: 0 errors, 0 warnings, the file passed all checks.
Step 3 Review and import: framework name, code, version and content counts, then Import as Draft.

steps.what: Check the requirements and activate the framework.
steps.result: Framework Activated: customers of SGS Taiwan can create workspaces with it.
body: A Draft framework is not offered to customers. Activate asks for confirmation.
shots: Imported framework in Draft, with its requirements tree.
Framework Activated; the message confirms it is available to customers of SGS Taiwan.

body: A scope is the part of the organisation that is certified: the organisation, a product or a system.
shots: Create scope form with type, name, company, address, employee count and scope of certification.
New scope detail: Create workspace starts a workspace for this scope.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Scope > Create workspace > Assisted workspace
steps.what: Create an Assisted workspace from the activated framework.
steps.result: Workspace created (Not started) with the requirements of the chosen tier.
body: Step 1 lists the activated frameworks. Step 2 sets the workspace name, the certification cycle (three years by default) and the tier. Requirements above the tier are out of scope.
shots: Step 1 Standard: the framework imported in step 1.
Step 2 Workspace details: name, cycle and tier Medium.
Workspace detail right after creation: 61 requirements in scope for tier Medium.

body: Each requirement lists its expected evidence. The uploaded file is scanned, then counts as that expected evidence.
shots: Requirement R.1.1.1 with its mandatory expected evidence EE-001.
Upload evidence panel: file, expected evidence type and description.
After upload: R.1.1.1 Provided, 1 of 1 mandatory evidence, workspace progress 1 of 61.

steps.what: Find the evidence in the documents library.
steps.result: One row per document, with scope, version, usage and status.
body: The Documents button of the workspace opens the documents library of the whole organisation.
shots: Documents library filtered by the file name.
Document detail: versions, where the document is used, Upload new version.

steps.what: Upload a new version of the document.
steps.result: Version 2 is current; version 1 stays in the history.
body: Requirements always use the current version. Versions cannot be changed after upload.
shots: Upload new version: one file, it becomes version 2.
Version history: v2 current, v1 kept.

steps.result: Status In progress with the evidence progress.
shots: Workspace summary: status In progress, 1 of 61 requirements with mandatory evidence.

blocked: Sign-in on the SGS environment with Microsoft Entra.
The test environment uses a mock sign-in; Entra is set up only on the SGS DEV/UAT environment.
Each role can sign in to its portal through Entra.
On the test environment all mail goes to Mailpit; real delivery depends on the SGS SMTP set-up.
Emails arrive, links in them open the right page.
Blocking an infected file at upload. Normal uploads are tested.
Pending: the malware scanner CrowdStrike is not connected yet. SGS IT is connecting it on the SGS environment.
An infected file shows Blocked and cannot be linked, downloaded or used.
